scene: Tick-tocking gears echo through the mansion's vast velvet foyer.
picture: Flat side view. Inside the grand foyer, the silver-haired grandmother in pink tracksuit stands on the red carpet holding her small white dog's lead. On the far left stands a towering silver grandfather clock. Centre sits an open glowing ledger on a pedestal. On the far right, a winding brass spiral staircase ascends upward.
shown: a towering silver grandfather clock ticking steadily on the far left
an open ledger glowing with cyan script on a mahogany pedestal centre
a winding brass spiral staircase leading upwards on the far right
